title: The Art Institute left a $1.06 million pledge to its landlord’s affiliate off the books

beats.text: The art school owed money to a nonprofit that also borrowed from it.

visual.sub: A pledge left out of the accounts

beats.text: The original accounts left that obligation out.

visual.kicker: A pledge left out of the accounts

beats.text: The affiliate borrowed for improvements at a leased property.

visual.kicker: Money moved in the other direction as well

beats.text: It had advanced $797,775 before the first note was signed.

visual.label: Money moved in the other direction as well

beats.text: The first note and the pledge each called for annual payments of $75,000.

visual.label: Money moved in the other direction as well

beats.text: Those payments ran in opposite directions under separate agreements.
The correction reduced opening net assets by $1,060,275.
The school agreed with the financial restatement.
The next audit marked the omission corrected. The pledge stayed on the books.
The remaining pledge was $864,051 at June 2020.

visual.label: The liability remained in later statements

beats.text: The signed agreements and ledger would establish how each installment was settled.
